Name: Magpul MOE SL AR15/M4 Carbine-Length Handguard - BLACK - MAG538-BLK
Natural: The MOE SL Hand Guard for AR15/M4 firearms with carbine-length gas system and A2 font sight* provides modular flexibility with M-LOK accessory slots in a lightweight, sleek, cost effective design. Designed with versatility in mind, M-LOK slots at the two, six, and ten o'clock positions allow the attachment of optional Picatinny rail sections and other direct-attach accessories for the mounting of tactical lights, slings, grips, etc. Reinforced, heat-resistant polymer construction provides operational durability without the weight and expense of an aluminum rail hand guard. Large front extensions and lower lip provides additional operator protection from hot front sight assembly. Made in U.S.A. Narrow design replaces bulky M4 Carbine-type plastic hand guards Easy to install utilizing existing delta ring and round front hand guard retaining cap M-LOK slots at the two, six, and ten o'clock positions for mounting MIL-STD-1913 Picatinny rails or other direct-attach accessories Reinforced, heat-resistant polymer construction Integral riveted aluminum heat shield Front lip and long side extensions shields hand from hot sight assembly Weight: 0.59 lb. Length, maximum: 8.9 in. Width, maximum: 1.8 in. Height: 2.4 in. NOTE: The MOE SL Hand Guard - Carbine-Length is a direct replacement for M4 carbine type hand guards and utilizes the existing round front hand guard retaining cap and delta ring. Will also fit most 7.62x51 weapons with a carbine length gas system. NOTE: Must be used with the triangular A2 front sight assembly; other gas blocks are not compatible. NOTE: Factory sling swivel is not compatible and, if equipped, must be removed from the A2 front sight assembly.

Name: BLACKHAWK! Leather Inside Pants Holster - 420401BK-L
Natural: For deep concealment for a secondary weapon, working undercover or just off-duty, this is the ideal choice. Features a shirt guard to keep leather between the slide and your body, to increase comfort and prevent shirt from blocking holster.
